findings: Figure 19.24 is used twice (sickle cell and chromosomal rearrangements); the second is recorded as Fig19.24b.

The Turner syndrome text lists 'low mental abilities' and a frequency of 1 in 5000 female births; most girls with Turner syndrome have normal intelligence, and the usual figure is about 1 in 2000-2500. The lesson gives the book's statements with these notes, flagged.

The Tidbit lists chromosome pairs '13, 15, 18, 21, and 2'; read as 22, consistent with the next sentence. 'Sister chromatids fail to separate' is the book's description of non-disjunction; homologues failing to separate in meiosis I is the other form.
